arxiv-2012-00911.title: Lower deviation probabilities for level sets of the branching random walk
arxiv-2012-00911.creator: Shuxiong Zhang
arxiv-2012-00911.description: Abstract Abstract: Given a branching random walk \{Z_{n}\}_{n\geq 0} on \mathbb{R} , let Z_{n}([y,\infty)) be the number of particles located in [y,\infty) at generation n . It is known from [ 10 ] that under some mild conditions, n^{-1}\log Z_{n}([\theta x^{*}n,\infty)) converges a.s. to \log m-I(\theta x^{*}) , where \log m-I(\theta x^{*}) is a positive constant.

arxiv-2104-07345.title: ROC: An Ontology for Country Responses towards COVID-19
arxiv-2104-07345.creator: Jamal Al Qundus, Ralph Schäfermeier, Naouel Karam, Silvio Peikert, Adrian Paschke
arxiv-2104-07345.description: Abstract The ROC ontology for country responses to COVID-19 provides a model for collecting, linking and sharing data on the COVID-19 pandemic. It follows semantic standardization (W3C standards RDF, OWL, SPARQL) for the representation of concepts and creation of vocabularies. ROC focuses on country measures and enables the integration of data from heterogeneous data sources.

arxiv-2107-07917.title: Mapping Lyman-alpha forest three-dimensional large scale structure in real and redshift space
arxiv-2107-07917.creator: Francesco Sinigaglia, Francisco-Shu Kitaura, Andrés Balaguera-Antolínez, Ikkoh Shimizu, Kentaro Nagamine, Manuel Sánchez-Benavente, Metin Ata
arxiv-2107-07917.description: Abstract This work presents a new physically-motivated supervised machine learning method, hydro-bam , to reproduce the three-dimensional Lyman- α \alpha forest field in real and in redshift space learning from a reference hydrodynamic simulation, thereby saving about 7 orders of magnitude in computing time.

arxiv-2203-16174.title: Status and plans of the Gravitational Behaviour of Antihydrogen at Rest experiment
arxiv-2203-16174.creator: PHILIPP BLUMER on behalf of the GBAR collaboration
arxiv-2203-16174.description: Abstract The GBAR experiment aims to directly test the Weak Equivalence Principle of ultracold antihydrogen in Earth’s gravitational field. The gravitational acceleration g ¯ \overline{g} will be measured to a precision of 1 % 1\,\% using a classical free fall of the anti-atoms from a fixed height.

arxiv-2209-10747.title: Re-examining the Bayesian colour excess estimation for the local star-forming galaxies observed in the HETDEX Pilot Survey 2022 Re-examining the Bayesian colour excess estimation for the local star-forming galaxies observed in the HETDEX Pilot Survey – References
arxiv-2209-10747.creator: Jong-Ho Shinn
arxiv-2209-10747.description: Abstract In my previous reanalysis of the local star-forming galaxies observed in the Hobby–Eberly Telescope Dark Energy Experiment (HETDEX) pilot survey, I reported that the overestimation of E ⁡ ( B − V ) E(B-V) , hence the star formation rate (SFR), undermined the claim of new galaxy population discovery in the original study.

arxiv-2311-04902.title: Beyond Size: How Gradients Shape Pruning Decisions in Large Language Models
arxiv-2311-04902.creator: Rocktim Jyoti Das, Mingjie Sun, Liqun Ma, Zhiqiang Shen
arxiv-2311-04902.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters are prime targets for network pruning, removing some model weights without hurting performance. Prior approaches such as magnitude pruning, SparseGPT, and Wanda, either concentrated solely on weights or integrated weights with activations for sparsity. However, they overlooked the informative gradients derived from pretrained LLMs.

arxiv-2409-15139.title: The Top Manifold Connectedness of Quantum Control Landscapes
arxiv-2409-15139.creator: Yidian Fan, Tak-San Ho, Gaurav Bhole, Re-Bing Wu, Herschel Rabitz
arxiv-2409-15139.description: Abstract The control of quantum systems has been proven to possess trap-free optimization landscapes under the satisfaction of proper assumptions. However, many details of the landscape geometry and their influence on search efficiency still need to be fully understood. This paper numerically explores the path-connectedness of globally optimal control solutions forming the top manifold of the landscape.

pmc-11653540.title: A rare case report of severe aplastic anaemia caused by long-term use of zidovudine
pmc-11653540.creator: Jing Zhou, Qi Wang, Yu’e Yu, Lingling Chen, Jinchuan Shi, Congxiang Huang, Rangxiao Zhuang
pmc-11653540.description: BackgroundZidovudine is an antiviral drug used to treat acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS). Anaemia is a common adverse effect of zidovudine that usually occurs in the first 2 to 4 weeks of initial treatment. Here, we describe a patient with HIV infection who developed severe aplastic anaemia 11 years after taking zidovudine.

pmc-12468767.title: Structural Complexity as a Directional Signature of System Evolution: Beyond Entropy
pmc-12468767.creator: Donglu Shi, Hans J Herrmann, Miguel Rubi
pmc-12468767.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We propose a universal framework for understanding system evolution based on structural complexity, offering a directional signature that applies across physical, chemical, and biological domains. Unlike entropy, which is constrained by its definition in closed, equilibrium systems, we introduce Kolmogorov Complexity (KC) and Fractal Dimension (FD) as quantifiable, scalable metrics that capture the emergence of organized complexity in open, non-equilibrium systems.

pmc-12605838.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025).
